title: Monetary Policy Committee decision
note: The CBK decides the Central Bank Rate, held at 8.75% on 11 August.

title: Tax amnesty closes
note: Penalties and interest are waived on principal tax paid by 31 December.

note: The new deadline for nil filers, starting with the 2026 year of income.

note: The new deadline for PAYE-only taxpayers, starting with the 2026 year of income.

title: AGOA extension runs out
